title: The criteria for selecting the evidence are clearly described.

chain_of_thought.step1_locate: Locating information in Methodology section under Literature Search
step2_evidence: A systematic search of the peer-reviewed literature from January 2009 through March 2016 was conducted to find evidence relevant to the key questions that focused on randomized trials, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses of fair or better quality.
chain_of_thought.step3_reasoning: The guideline describes inclusion criteria including study design (randomized trials, systematic reviews, meta-analyses), quality (fair or better), and time frame (January 2009-March 2016). However, it does not describe exclusion criteria. The scoring principle for 3-4 is 'Mention of inclusion (or exclusion) criteria only'. Since the guideline mentions inclusion criteria (study design, quality, time frame) but does not mention exclusion criteria, it falls under the 3-4 score range. The inclusion criteria description includes more than just study type (as required for score 2), so it qualifies for the higher end of the 3-4 range (score 4).
